capabilities: convert Logseq syntax to Markdown when opening files
render ((block-id)) references as inline content previews
convert id:: block IDs to Obsidian ^block-id syntax
summarize CLOCK durations under :LOGBOOK: and append them to DONE tasks
configure how TODO / DOING / DONE keywords are displayed or converted
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown formatter; it only converts Logseq-specific syntax, not Markdown layout.
extras: Author accepts donations via WeChat QR code.
problem: Notes migrated from Logseq use Logseq-specific syntax (id:: properties, ((block references)), :LOGBOOK:, TODO keywords) that Obsidian does not render or understand.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that automatically converts Logseq syntax to Markdown.

summary: Logseq syntax converter that automatically rewrites Logseq-specific markup to Markdown when an MD file is opened, including block IDs and LOGBOOK entries.
